summary: 预算/ETC（WP-BUDGET/ETC）契约冻结首片 on BASE 15cf20c, docs-only. Per Lead ruling (same as PH-308; the BASE PH-306 exact allowlist has no docs/adr entry), the frozen budget/ETC contract is written into project/specs/PH-306.md. It covers: project budget baseline with append-only versions (project/period YYYY-MM/version number), draft->approved->superseded state machine (approved amounts/periods/effective dates immutable; replacement only by a new approved version with no overlapping/double-active version), effective_from frozen at approval, integer-cent lines >= 0 in frozen subjects labor/expense/procurement/other, per-version subject+contract-line uniqueness, four-eyes approval, request_token receipt + expected_version + company lock + audit, as_of latest approved effective version or missing; ETC frozen default method budget_residual_v1 (ETC=max(0, approved budget - posted incurred cost), EAC=incurred+ETC, budget_variance, over_budget/gap, remaining_budget), with missing/null whenever budget or cost is absent or unreadable (never zero), incurred cost only from costing owner posted book=cost/origin=current postings including negative reversals (explicitly excluding cash payments, settlements/revenue, unapproved fee drafts, budgets themselves and unposted costs), and optional remaining-workload/contract-remaining methods only via explicit new planning; gap/unallocated budget semantics including budget_lines_exceed_total issue; cross-owner boundaries (costing owns cost facts, time provides labor facts through costing, contracts owns contract lines, settlement/revenue are revenue-side and excluded from ETC, cash payments are not cost, budget owner cannot become a second cost/cash owner); read-only display/reconciliation requiring approved budget/incurred/ETC/EAC/gap/version/effective date/method/as_of plus missing/refs and no side effects; role rules owner/finance budget write, auditor read, pm managed project summary, member denied, disabled-module history read, unauth 403; canonical/API/migration boundaries (no new canonical/model/migration/route here, PH-313 plans the write implementation, migration leaf applied against real BASE, history recomputation only through explicit migration/backfill); 12 rejection cases; acceptance/completion and an explicit not-implemented list. No product code, model, migration, schema, route, canonical event or docs/adr file was written and no existing write path or business fact changed. Reviewer round-1 blocker fixed: the budget-version state machine now freezes the complete enum draft/approved/superseded/rejected with legal transitions draft->approved, draft->rejected (terminal, required reason, audited, never effective/as_of), approved->superseded only by approving a replacement, superseded/rejected as terminal states that cannot return to draft/approved.
